name: POS Transaction Fee
description: POS Transaction Fee allows you to configure and apply transaction charges in Odoo Point of Sale. Charges can be defined as either fixed amounts (e.g., $2 per order) or percentage-based (e.g., 2% of the order total).
summary: POS Transaction Fee lets you easily configure and apply extra charges in Odoo Point of Sale. You can define fees as a fixed amount (e.g., $2 per order) or a percentage of the order total (e.g., 2%). The fee is automatically applied at checkout, clearly shown on the POS screen and customer receipt, and recorded in the backend and accounting for accurate reporting. POS Transaction Fee is a powerful Odoo module that enables businesses to automatically apply transaction charges during Point of Sale operations. Whether you want to recover payment gateway costs, bank charges, or service fees, this module helps you configure charges as either fixed amounts (e.g., $2 per order) or percentage-based (e.g., 2% of the order total). The module is highly flexible - you can apply fees to specific payment methods (like credit cards or mobile wallets) while excluding others (like cash). This ensures accurate, real-world handling of different payment scenarios. Once configured, the fee is automatically calculated and displayed on the POS payment screen. After validation, the fee is included in the customer receipt (printed or emailed), ensuring transparency at every step. name: POS Waiter Table Locking
description: The POS Waiter Lock Table app helps restaurants avoid confusion by making sure only one waiter can handle a table at a time. When a waiter opens a table, it gets locked for them until the order is finished or canceled
summary: The POS Waiter Lock Table app is designed to streamline restaurant operations by ensuring that each table can only be managed by one waiter at a time. Once a waiter opens a table, it is automatically locked under their control, preventing others from making changes and avoiding confusion. The table remains locked until the order is completed, canceled, or transferred, ensuring smooth service and clear accountability. The POS Waiter Table Lock & Transfer app is designed to improve restaurant operations in Odoo Point of Sale (POS) system. It helps restaurants avoid confusion when multiple waiters manage the same tables, ensuring smooth service and accurate order handling. With this app, tables can be locked to the waiter currently handling them, preventing other staff from accidentally adding items or modifying orders. This reduces mistakes, avoids conflicts, and improves accountability among staff. At the same time, the app provides flexible options to transfer or merge orders between tables when needed, supporting real-life dining situations like customers changing seats, combining tables, or splitting groups. name: POS Lot & Serial Selection
description: This module extends Odoo Point of Sale (POS) by allowing cashiers to select Lot/Serial Numbers directly during the POS sales process. It also supports Expiration Date tracking for better inventory management
summary: The POS Lot/Serial Selection Module provides a seamless solution for managing serialized products within Odoo’s Point of Sale system. This module ensures that every item sold through POS can be tracked with precise lot or serial numbers, enabling businesses to maintain accurate inventory control, streamline operations, and enhance product traceability. In the backend, users can easily create and manage lot/serial numbers for products. For example, a product like Storage Box can have multiple serial numbers assigned (e.g., Ser/01, Ser/02, Ser/03, Ser/04). Each serial number is tied to its own available quantity, expiration date, and history, ensuring businesses can track stock at the most detailed level. The system also provides options for replenishment and history review, helping managers stay informed about stock levels and product movements. In the POS interface, when a cashier selects a serialized product, a popup appears prompting them to choose from available lot/serial numbers. The interface displays key details such as available quantity, expiration date, removal date, and use date for each serial number, allowing accurate selection during sales. This step eliminates errors and ensures the right serials are allocated to customers. Users can adjust the required quantity by increasing or decreasing the number of units selected for each serial, making the process flexible and straightforward. name: POS Hide Product Information
description: Overview  The POS Hide Product Information module for Odoo allows you to control the visibility of sensitive product data in the Point of Sale interface.
summary: The POS Hide Product Information module for Odoo is a powerful and flexible tool designed to enhance data security and user control within the Point of Sale (POS) interface. In many retail environments, sales personnel or cashiers use the POS system daily, but they do not necessarily need access to sensitive product information such as cost price, profit margin, or internal stock levels. This module helps businesses maintain confidentiality and prevent the accidental disclosure of internal financial data by allowing administrators to selectively hide product details in the POS view. With this module installed, administrators can easily configure which information should be visible or hidden in the POS product information popup. This configuration is found under Settings - Point of Sale - Hide Product Info in POS. From there, users can enable or disable multiple options such as hiding product inventory details, financial data, pricing information, order summaries, and edit/replacement buttons. Each option works independently, providing full flexibility to adapt to different operational or privacy needs.
